name: app-pale-circles-four-week-design-process-slide
title: Four-Week Process in Overlapping Circles
whatItIs: A near-white slide with a two-typeface headline and four huge overlapping thin-line circles, each labelled with a week tag, a stage name (Discover, Define, Structure, Design) and a one-line description.
whatItMeans: Overlapping circles suggest stages that build on one another. Hairline strokes keep it elegant.
techniques: Giant hairline circles as containers for each stage
Small square nodes at the circle intersections
Week chips above each stage title
Light sans with italic serif emphasis in the headline
Circles cropped by the canvas edges

vocabulary.definition: Circles that intersect to show connected stages.
A tiny square or dot on a line marking a point.
A small label with a time range.
